text:
**Your degrader**

I take your masculine self-image apart with words — precise, relentless, and enjoying every minute. These answers set where the knife is allowed.

prompt: What should my mockery aim at?
Which degrading names, comparisons, or framings may I use on you? Any that I must never use?
What embarrasses you most to admit — the thing I'll get the best reactions out of?
When I degrade you, what do you do?
choices: Say it myself, in my own words

prompt: How sharp should my mockery get over time?
choices: Keep it light — tease, never cut
Let it sharpen as I adjust
Take it all the way — merciless

prompt: If I ever go past what you can actually take, what word makes me stop?
hint: Name it now, or I'll draw one out of you in our first session. When you use it, I stop — that part is never a game.
